title: Roles & Permissions
description: Choose what managers and users are allowed to do. Admins always have every permission.

roleHints.user: The default role for members. Users can do exactly what is ticked in this column, and nothing else.
roleHints.manager: A member with its own, usually wider set of permissions — grant more than users get without making someone an admin.
roleHints.admin: Full access to the organisation and to these settings. Admins always hold every permission and cannot be restricted.

permissionHints.assign_users_to_teams: Add members to a team and remove them again. Does not allow creating or deleting teams.
permissionHints.manage_own_skills: Create, edit and delete your own skills, including their instructions, sources and integrations.
permissionHints.install_marketplace_skills: Add skills from the Ayunis Core Marketplace to your own skills.
permissionHints.request_skill_transfer: Make one of your own skills available to a team you belong to.
permissionHints.request_skill_transfer_org: Make one of your own skills available to the whole organisation.
permissionHints.manage_own_knowledge: Create, edit and delete your own knowledge bases and the documents inside them.
permissionHints.request_knowledge_transfer: Make one of your own knowledge bases available to a team you belong to.
permissionHints.request_knowledge_transfer_org: Make one of your own knowledge bases available to the whole organisation.

adminHint: Admins always have every permission and cannot be restricted.
minOnePermission: Each role must keep at least one permission
